card.name: Opening quote in reference lists
card.fires_on: The opening double quotation mark that starts a new entry in a bulleted web reference or citation list. It comes right after a dash and a previous entry's 'Retrieved' date.

modes.label: Quote after retrieval date
modes.description: A quote mark opening the next cited page title, after a prior entry's 'Retrieved' date and a dash.
modes.example: June 2005. Retrieved 2007-06-26. -<< ">>UK cancer mortality statistics by age". Cancer

modes.label: Quote after book citation
modes.description: A quote mark opening a web page title after a book citation with page number.

card.plain: It marks the start of a quoted page title in a list of web citations at the end of an article.
